ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white dominance across approximately 85% of visible surface area, with a low-intensity black border and discrete vertical linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid white central and lower fluke field; continuous black pigmentation band along the entire trailing edge; localized dark mottling on the distal left tip; four distinct dark vertical linear streaks (two per lobe) extending from the trailing edge toward the center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetric V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire superior boundary; irregular tooth-like peaks most prominent on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory from the median notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a convex curve at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four prominent, near-vertical dark linear marks; two on the left lobe and two on the right lobe, clearly breaking the white high-intensity field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct vertical rake marks (linear abrasions) across both lobes; jagged irregular erosion of the trailing edge on the left distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant high-intensity specular highlights (glare) and water droplets occluding the pixel data in the lower central region near the water interface.
